title: SentinelPipe v1 common definitions
description: Shared value types referenced by the other v1 schemas.

timestamp.description: UTC instant in RFC 3339 format, microsecond precision.

nullableTimestamp.description: UTC instant in RFC 3339 format, or null when the event has not happened.

displayName.description: Human-readable name. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed by the server. Control characters are rejected.

gitBranchName.description: Short Git branch name (for example 'main' or 'feature/login'). Conservative subset of git check-ref-format: ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' and '/'. Full refs ('refs/...'), 'HEAD', '..', '//', components starting with '.' or ending with '.lock', and trailing '/' or '.' are rejected. Case-sensitive.

commitSha.description: Full Git commit object name: 40 (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256) lowercase hexadecimal characters.
